title: Generic local constancy reflected by finite module direct image
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $f:X\to Y$ a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], with $Y$ Noetherian, and $F$ an etale $\Lambda$-module sheaf. Let $V\subseteq Y$ be a dense open on which $f_*F$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant]. There is a dense open $U\subseteq V$ of $Y$ such that $F|_{f^{-1}(U)}$ is locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant]. No assertion is made on the complement of this open, and no finite generation assertion is made about F.

proof.text: Apply exists_dense_open_finite_noetherian_scheme_splitting to f and the dense V. This supplies U <= V, density, an etale covering family of U, and a disjoint finite partition into universal-homeomorphism pieces over each cover member. No sheaf is used in these geometric choices.

Pull the given finite locally constant f_*F on V back along U to V. Use Etale.upperStarComp and homOfLE_ι to identify it with its restriction to U. Use the finite exchange isomorphism for the restriction square to get finite local constancy of the direct image of G=F restricted to f inverse-image U. For each member of the etale cover of U, pull back again and use finite exchange for its cartesian square. The direct image of the pulled-back G is finite locally constant.

For each split component obtain its direct-image retract from nonempty_retract_lowerStar_of_disjoint_open_partition. Prove locallyConstant_of_retract explicitly: for a retract e of F the complementary projector is the identity minus the composite e.r followed by e.i, and e.i annihilates it. IsLocallyConstantSheaf.kernel_and_cokernel gives local constancy of its kernel, without a Noetherian coefficient hypothesis. Construct its isomorphism to the retract using kernel inclusion followed by e.r and kernel.lift of e.i; the retract identity and kernel equation prove the inverse identities.

For each component universal homeomorphism q, use Etale.isEquivalence_lowerStar, pull back its locally constant direct image, and transport across the invertible adjunction counit to show the component restriction is locally constant. The finite disjoint open cover, changed to an etale cover, descends this to the pulled-back source. Finally apply IsLocallyConstantSheaf.of_cover to the pullback of the etale covering family along the restricted finite map. Return U, its inclusion in V, density, and local constancy. The proof works for empty covers and empty partitions without choosing a member.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dense_open_locallyConstant_of_finite_lowerStar_module
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (V : Y.Opens) (hV : Dense (V : Set Y))
    (h : IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
      ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) V.ι).obj
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F))) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, U ≤ V ∧ Dense (U : Set Y) ∧
      IsLocallyConstantSheaf
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj F)
